findings.title: Missing clickjacking protection (frame-ancestors / X-Frame-Options)
findings.description: The page can be embedded in a frame on any origin because neither a CSP frame-ancestors directive nor an X-Frame-Options header is sent.
findings.impact: An attacker page could overlay the board and trick a user into clicking Delete or Move.
findings.recommendation: Serve the site from a host that can set response headers, or add a frame-busting check as a fallback.
findings.fix:
// Fallback in the script's INIT section:
if (window.top !== window.self) { document.body.hidden = true; }

findings.title: Third-party GitHub Actions pinned by tag, not commit SHA
findings.owasp: A08:2021 – Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.description: Actions are referenced by mutable major-version tags.
findings.impact: A compromised tag could run attacker code in the deploy job.
findings.recommendation: Pin each action to a full commit SHA with the version in a comment.
